observations: Two retail boxes for 'X6 Wireless Controller' are visible.
The boxes are sealed with clear plastic windows.
A coiled black USB cable and a UK-style power plug are laid out.
A white PlayStation 4 Pro console is visible beneath the boxes.
The console appears to be in a protective white plastic case.
The image contains a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAME ARENAOFFICIAL'.
No photos of the actual controllers or the console's ports are provided.

claims.evidence: The console is visible in photo 0, but the model name is not legible on the box or the console itself.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of a controller being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may have a faulty disc drive or optical sensor.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware failure such as a blue light of death.
risks.proof: A video showing the console running a diagnostic tool.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of a controller being used to navigate the system menu.
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
Photo of the ports on the back of the console.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
